scope: Supplied lifecycle/readonly eligibility code; review itself made no requests or credential reads.
limits: OpenRouter public catalog endpoints omit ancillary per-request and reasoning token pricing fields; per-request zero-price caps and free-policy enforcement remain authoritative at the runner engine wire level.
Single-provider hard constraint: eligibility requires exactly one endpoint provided by 'Stealth' with status == 0; any secondary route or status alteration fails closed.
Strict 60-second validity window: launcher must be invoked immediately after eligibility-read-only.py executes.
Permanent admission consumption: once claimed by the runner, admission is committed to the parent worktree and archive, permanently preventing rerun.

Fail-closed execution: any unexpected process termination, watchdog error, or absence of status 'PILOT_COMPLETE_LABELS_PENDING' halts with non-zero exit code and requires manual audit; auto-replay is strictly prohibited.
